sentences.text: In 1940, France was under Nazi control.
They lived in a small village.
One day, Isabelle met a man.
She took care of her daughter, Sophie.
She hid them in her home.
She gave them food and clothes.
One night, the Nazis came to the village.
Vianne hid the children in the cellar.
The Nazis did not find them.
Isabelle and Gaëtan fell in love.
They dreamed of a free France.
He was taken by the Nazis.
Vianne did not know if he was alive.
She hoped he would come back.
He and Isabelle were together again.
They had fought for their country.
